Hydrangeaceae.key_door: opposite Philadelphus shrub + 4 petals + many stamens + inferior/half-inferior ovary + capsule

Loasaceae.key_door: barbed/stinging hairs + many stamens + inferior ovary + capsule

Cornaceae.key_door: opposite arcuate-veined leaves + 4-stamen flowers + inferior ovary + drupe

lineage_lesson: Cornales shares inferior-ovary architecture but expresses it through very different field forms: mock-orange shrubs, rough/stinging herbs, and dogwood shrubs/trees.
guardrails: Do not use opposite leaves alone for Hydrangeaceae or Cornaceae.
Do not use stinging hairs alone for Loasaceae; confirm flower and ovary characters.
